title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Sales Development agent books seller meetings for prospects
summary: The briefing passes: the scheduling description and rollout targets match the roadmap, and Microsoft documentation supports the activation and blocking controls. Preview billing is correctly distinguished from unpublished general-availability terms, and the scheduling-specific gaps remain unconfirmed after targeted searches.
